supplement.text:
**Wolflag** is your go-to partner for custom national flags, serving distributors, importers, institutions, and large-scale event projects. 

We cover every display need—whether it’s hanging indoors or outdoors, sitting on a desk, waving in a crowd, or taking center stage at an international ceremony.

 Every order is built to your exact specs: choose your countries, sizes, materials, finishing styles, and packaging. And when it comes to multi-country orders, we make sure every single flag in your shipment matches in quality and build.
supplement.title: Custom National Flags, Built for Scale
supplement.imageAlt: Custom national flags featuring durable canvas headers and brass grommets, folded uniformly for bulk multi-country orders

optionBlocks.title: Production Options for National Flags
optionBlocks.text:
Wolflag manufactures custom national flags in printed, sewn, and embroidered styles—available in both single-reverse and double-sided formats to match your display environment, order volume, and project specs. You have full control over every production detail, from custom dimensions and weather-resistant fabrics to heavy-duty canvas headers, brass grommets, pole sleeves, reinforced stitching, and bulk or retail-ready packaging.

Sourcing multiple country designs in a single order? Our production team standardizes specifications across your entire batch, ensuring every flag matches in exact size, fabric weight, finishing, and packaging.

items.title: Printed National Flags
items.text: Fast, cost-effective bulk production—perfect for multi-country assortments and consistent repeat orders.

items.title: Sewn / Embroidered Flags
items.text: Built for ceremonial, institutional, and heavy-duty outdoor displays—featuring pieced sewn panels, precision appliqué, dense embroidery, weather-resistant fabrics, and reinforced finishing.

items.title: Single-Reverse National Flags
items.text: Engineered for lightweight outdoor flying, effortless performance in light winds, and cost-effective bulk sourcing.

items.title: Double-Sided National Flags
items.text: Built for high-profile displays where intricate emblems and text must read correctly on both sides with bold, zero-show-through visibility.

items.title: Size & Fabric Options
items.text: Available in standard flagpole dimensions, official country proportions, or custom project sizes—paired with commercial-grade fabrics tailored for indoor, outdoor, or high-wind displays.

items.title: Finishing & Packaging Options
items.text: Configured with heavy-duty canvas headers, solid brass grommets, pole sleeves, and reinforced fly stitching—delivered in bulk cartons, pre-sorted country kits, or retail-ready packaging.

sizeChart.text: Each custom flag comes in a variety of sizes, depending on the shape of the flag you select. Rectangular flags are available in our Small and Standard sizes (see chart below). If you are looking for a specific custom size, we are happy to create almost anything you need.
